comparison_plan.deltas: intervention minus baseline (ΔY on-time count, ΔC measured bytes)
comparison_plan.descriptive_only: counts and distributions; no significance test, no classifier, no threshold fitting, no new policy
comparison_plan.independence_warning: up to 96 interventions over only 16 scenes; interventions are not 96 independent scenes and per-scene gains are not added up to predict joint sends
per_sample: actor-visible features and analysis metadata (kept separate)
comparison_plan.unit: per intervention cell against the same scene's baseline

gate.first_scene: baseline(1300000) must equal its disabled-interceptor cell on every behaviour field and tape line
gate.per_sample_prefix: the intervention tape before the intervention step must be the baseline tape, and the frozen point's state must reproduce the baseline row at that step
gate.synthetic_only: zero-environment, zero-optimizer synthetic checks; the full production unittest suite is NOT re-run this round (its scope was registered in ROUND27_SCOPE_REGISTRATION.json)

intervention.mechanism: ROUND27's FirstReportAdvancer, imported read-only; one HOLD->SEND override per cell at the frozen (scene, target, step)
not_allowed: second send for the same target
target id as a new actor feature
intervention.same_scene_restart: each intervention cell re-runs the whole episode from the scene's initial state; the prefix must reproduce the baseline until the intervention step

launch_budget.counting_rule: every failure, retry and smoke run counts; fewer interventions are fine, no top-up with other targets or scenes

controller_parameter_summary.note: actor+task critic mirror the pilot round's Controller; the cost head is the constrained objective's addition (Stage A: new trainer state)

identity.decode: SEND iff p(SEND) >= p(HOLD), ties to SEND (original frozen greedy decode)

parameters.note: actor+task critic mirror the pilot round's Controller; the cost head is the constrained objective's addition (Stage A: new trainer state)

scenes.scene_selection_rule: the fixed first 16 of the registered training block; no new selection rule, no outcome-based scene swap

selection_algorithm.rule: per baseline target: the first tape step where the target is actionable (sequential shadow gate: payable in transport order); an intervention point exists only if the original greedy action there is HOLD

stopping_rules: stop after the frozen plan completes, or on a technical-health/quota stop
an unexplained baseline/disabled drift stops the round
a failed prefix reproduction is reported as a technical problem; no nearby-moment substitution
no continued training, no candidate swap, no confirmation, no deployment
